display.title: Making the Most of Summer Vacation: Discovering Hashem's Beautiful World
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains how summer vacation is a chance to get to know Hashem better, and the three daily mitzvos that bring a safe and healthy summer.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show in the middle of summer vacation. Uncle Yossi explains that vacation is a time to rest from the daily routine, but also a chance to get to know Hashem better than ever. All year long we are mostly indoors, in shul, in school and at home. In the summer we are outdoors, visiting parks, botanical gardens and zoos and traveling in the countryside, where we can marvel at the tall trees, colorful flowers and blooming fields painted by the greatest Artist of all, Hashem. So we should use this precious time wisely, as a stairway that brings us closer to Hashem. To earn Hashem's blessing for a safe and healthy summer, we must do three things every day: learn Torah, daven, and give tzedakah. Uncle Yossi then tells listeners about Tzivos Hashem's phone line for help choosing a truly Jewish day camp or overnight camp: Shomer Shabbos, strictly kosher, with time for davening and Torah study, and counselors who care for both body and neshamah. The clip ends as the Hakochainik march is announced.
display.lesson: Use summer vacation to discover Hashem in His world, and learn Torah, daven and give tzedakah every day.
